meta.name: newsletter-curation
meta.description: Newsletter curation with content sourcing, editorial structure, and subscriber growth strategies. Covers issue formatting, link roundups, commentary style, and sending cadence. Use for: email newsletters, link roundups, weekly digests, curated content, creator newsletters. Triggers: newsletter, email newsletter, newsletter curation, weekly digest, link roundup, curated newsletter, newsletter writing, newsletter format, subscriber growth, newsletter strategy, content curation, newsletter template

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 策划并发送邮件简报，提升订阅增长
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要定期制作并优化邮件简报。
copy.tagline_en: Curate and send email newsletters to grow subscribers.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to regularly create and optimize email newsletters.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你策划和撰写邮件通讯，包括内容搜集、格式排版、撰写评论、制定发送频率和增长策略。
howto.when: 当你提到“newsletter”、“weekly digest”、“link roundup”等关键词，或要求创建或优化邮件通讯时触发。

say.text: 帮我策划一期本周AI新闻的邮件通讯。
say.note: Claude 会调用搜索工具搜集内容并生成通讯草稿。

say.text: 给我一个通讯模板，包含大故事和链接精选。
如何提高我的通讯打开率？
say.note: Claude 会提供主题行优化和发送频率建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you curate and write email newsletters, including content sourcing, formatting, commentary writing, sending cadence, and growth strategies.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "newsletter", "weekly digest", "link roundup", or ask to create or optimize an email newsletter.

say_en.text: Help me curate a newsletter about this week's AI news.
say_en.note: Claude will search for content and generate a draft.

say_en.text: Give me a newsletter template with a big story and link roundup.
say_en.note: Claude will output a Deep Dive + Links format template.

say_en.text: How can I improve my newsletter open rate?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest subject line and frequency tips.
